verdict.rationale: RingCentral is a developer-facing communications platform, so an official CLI is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence pack documents one. The pack covers SDKs (JavaScript, Java, .NET), MCP servers, low-code Embeddable and no-code Workflow Builder; SDKs are developer building blocks and MCP servers belong to a different story, so neither counts here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
